paragraph_text: The Beneficiary satisfies 8 C.F.R. §204.5(h)(3)(i) by demonstrating receipt of nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field. The Beneficiary was selected as a scholar of Beijing's 'Hundred People Project,' a prestigious talent recognition program that identifies and supports exceptional academics in China [Exhibit A1, p.2]. This selection demonstrates that the Beneficiary has been recognized at the highest levels of academic excellence in China, as the program specifically targets scholars who have made significant contributions to their fields [Exhibit A1, p.2]. The 'Hundred People Project' represents a highly competitive selection process, as it identifies only a limited number of scholars from across all academic disciplines in Beijing, one of China's leading educational and research centers [Exhibit A1, p.2]. This award places the Beneficiary among an elite group of scholars recognized for their outstanding contributions to academic research and innovation [Exhibit A1, p.2]. Furthermore, the Beneficiary's work 'On Age' won the third prize of Outstanding Achievements in Humanities and Social Sciences of the Ministry of Education of China, a nationally recognized award established by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China in 2009 [Exhibit A1, p.2; Exhibit B10, p.2; Exhibit B10, p.4]. This award is administered by the Ministry of Education, which established an Award Committee composed of the director and deputy directors of the Social Sciences Committee of the Ministry of Education, convenors of each department, and heads of relevant departments, bureaus, and units to oversee the evaluation process [Exhibit B10, p.5]. The evaluation committee selects experts and scholars with high academic attainments from across the country to review submissions according to strict criteria including theoretical achievements, academic innovation, and contribution to discipline construction [Exhibit B10, p.5; Exhibit B10, p.6]. The award is highly selective, being conferred only every three years and divided into grand prizes, first prizes, second prizes, and third prizes, with the Beneficiary's third prize representing recognition among the top achievements in humanities and social sciences research across all Chinese higher education institutions [Exhibit B10, p.4; Exhibit B10, p.5]. In addition to the above, the Beneficiary received the Data Awards Data Legacy of the Year Award in 2019, a prestigious recognition in the field of mobile Internet and big data [Exhibit B1, p.2]. The Data Awards is one of the most influential awards in the field of mobile Internet, jointly launched by Umen+, Zhongguancun Big Data Industry Alliance, Tsingdata Big Data Industries Association, and China Big Data Industry Observation [Exhibit B3, p.2; Exhibit B3, p.3]. The selection process was rigorous, involving a jury of 21 judges from dozens of authorities and industry experts and scholars including China Academy of Information and Communications Technology, Tsinghua University, and Peking University, who reviewed candidates over a two-month period [Exhibit B3, p.3]. The award is highly competitive, with only 28 individuals standing out from the entire field to receive Data Awards across seven categories, placing the Beneficiary among an elite group recognized for their deep work in big data and mobile Internet [Exhibit B3, p.4; Exhibit B3, p.7]. The Data Legacy of the Year Award specifically recognizes individuals who have been working deeply in the field for many years, spreading insights and experiences, educating the whole industry, and leading Internet practitioners to continuously inherit data application, industry methodology, and scientific research [Exhibit B3, p.7]. Moreover, the Beneficiary's paper titled 'Challenges Posed by the Internet to Traditional Media in the Time Dimension - A Study on the Possibility of Internet Media Usage Time Surpassing Traditional Media Usage Time' won the Excellent Paper Award at the 11th China Communication Conference [Exhibit B11, p.2]. This award was conferred by the Communication Association of China through the 11th China Communication Conference Organizing Committee, demonstrating recognition from China's premier professional association for communication studies [Exhibit B11, p.2]. The China Communication Conference represents a major national gathering of communication scholars and professionals, making the Excellent Paper Award a competitive recognition of scholarly excellence in the field [Exhibit B11, p.2]. This award places the Beneficiary among a select group of researchers whose work has been recognized as exemplary by the leading professional organization in Chinese communication studies [Exhibit B11, p.2]. Additionally, the Beneficiary has received multiple additional industry and enterprise awards that further demonstrate his recognition across various sectors, including the Enterprise Service High-growth Company award from 36 Kr, China Big Data Industry Application TOP Choice Three Major Fields, 2019 China Big Data Innovative Enterprises TOP 100, 2018 Excellent Team Award of Internet Security Management from Chaoyang Public Security Branch Network Security Guarding Brigade, and Annual Best Retailing Intelligent Data Application Award from The 14th Shanghai Retail Industry Summit & Retail Innovation Summit 2019 [Exhibit B4, p.4]. These awards come from diverse and prestigious organizations including 36 Kr (a leading Chinese technology media), Data Technology Industry Innovation Institute (DTiii), Chaoyang Public Security Branch Network Security Guarding Brigade, and The 14th Shanghai Retail Industry Summit & Retail Innovation Summit 2019 [Exhibit B4, p.4]. The 2019 China Big Data Innovative Enterprises TOP 100 award specifically recognizes the top 100 innovative enterprises in China's big data industry, placing the Beneficiary's work among the most innovative in the country [Exhibit B4, p.4]. These multiple recognitions across different industry sectors—from enterprise services and big data innovation to internet security and retail intelligence—demonstrate the breadth and depth of the Beneficiary's impact and the consistent excellence of his work as recognized by various authoritative organizations in their respective fields [Exhibit B4, p.4]. In sum, the foregoing evidence clearly establishes that the Beneficiary has received nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field.
